title: eulophia adenoglossa
intro: Eulophia adenoglossa, commonly known as the yellow-flowered orchid, is a species of orchid native to tropical Africa. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of Eulophia adenoglossa include wound healing, antiseptic, and antiviral activities. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
